data.narrative:
Texture Energy is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Sanjiv Sanghavi, Victor Quinn, and Nicholas Brown that has raised $24.3M to date. The valuation exercise draws on a broader Climate & Energy sector peer set comprising one public company (LNZA) and eight private-stage peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

The stage-progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total capital raised of $24.3M as a proxy for enterprise value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $49M. This reflects typical investor return expectations and funding velocity patterns within the stage cohort. A peer-median approach could not be reliably deployed due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrower Climate & Energy peer universe; while nine sector peers exist broadly, fewer than three meet the specificity thresholds required for meaningful median-based triangulation.

The single-method analysis supports a valuation range of $41M to $56M, with a median point estimate of $49M. Key uncertainties include Texture Energy's specific technology differentiation within the crowded climate tech landscape, burn rate relative to capital deployed, and customer traction or go-to-market readiness—none of which are quantified in available data. A future valuation update would benefit from revenue run-rate or customer commitment metrics to anchor the analysis beyond stage-based assumptions.
